title: extension points (shared shape of agent-kit and stack-kit)
description: Every place a host extends the kit, declared once. A host file or entry is created from its template on demand (`extend <point> [<name>]`), carries <<pending: question>> markers for the answers only the host can give, and is upgraded by a 3-way merge when the template changes. The kit copy is never edited: the served result is the kit's base composed with the host's extensions as `merges_into` says.

host_path.description: Where the host's file goes, from the host root; <name> for a `many` point; `file#/json/pointer` for an entry inside a JSON file (`-` appends to an array); {manifest.field|default} for a path the manifest names

template.description: The kit file it is made from (scaffold/..., config/extension-templates/...); <name> picks a named template

schema.description: What validates the result (a schema file, or a pointer into one)

required_by.description: The profiles that require it answered (`init`: created by init)

merges_into.description: How the kit serves it: instance | overlay | catalog | registry | list

companions.description: Points made with this one, under the same name (comma-separated ids), e.g. an infra service's manifest entry
